Sova plans to keep their cardio interesting by incorporating High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT) into their routine. HIIT involves quick bursts of intense exercise followed by short recovery periods, which is known to be highly effective and fun due to the rapid switching between exercises. This method not only keeps the heart rate up but also offers a dynamic and engaging way to challenge the body, preventing boredom and offering a varied workout experience. Sova appreciates the energy boost that comes from HIIT sessions and acknowledges its benefits in improving overall fitness levels, particularly in building endurance and strength. They seem enthusiastic about trying it out and are open to suggestions from the group for additional workout variety to maintain their motivation and advancement in their fitness journey.
